title: Canonical derived etale scalar-change mate
statement:
Let $A,B$ be commutative rings in the coefficient universe, $\varphi:A\to B$ a unital ring homomorphism, and $f:Z\to W$ an arbitrary morphism of schemes. Work in ordinary unbounded small-etale derived module categories [def-weil-pbc-derived-categories]. Write $T_V=-\otimes_A^LB_V$ for canonical derived scalar extension [lem-pur-derived-change-of-rings], and $Lf_R^*\dashv Rf_{*,R}$ for the canonical derived geometric adjunction, with counit $\varepsilon_{f,R}$ [lem-pc-derived-adjoint-functors], [def-kun-projection-formula-map]. Let $c_f:Lf_B^*T_W\xrightarrow{\sim}T_ZLf_A^*$ be the normalized scalar/pullback isomorphism [def-pur-etale-scalar-pullback-iso]. Define the $B$-linear scalar-change natural transformation
$$q_f=\operatorname{scalarMate}(\varphi,f):T_WRf_{*,A}\longrightarrow Rf_{*,B}T_Z$$
as the mate of $c_f$ under these two derived adjunctions [def-weil-pbc-adjunction-mate]. Thus for $K\in D(Z_{\mathrm{et}},A)$ its component is the $Lf_B^*\dashv Rf_{*,B}$ transpose of
$$Lf_B^*T_WRf_{*,A}K\xrightarrow{c_{f,Rf_{*,A}K}}T_ZLf_A^*Rf_{*,A}K\xrightarrow{T_Z(\varepsilon_{f,A,K})}T_ZK.$$
This defines the canonical map and does not assert its invertibility. No flatness, boundedness, finiteness or properness hypothesis is imposed.
